{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Count how many completed orders have non-zero revenue (i.e., actual sales)
actual_completed_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] > 0]

len(actual_completed_orders)"}
